sources.note: Main homepage. Cloud-based EHR with customization focus, 24/7 support, targets healthcare providers, practice managers, billing professionals. San Antonio, TX.
Company history: CMI est. 1990, Sevocity first live customer 2002, CCHIT 2008, MU 2011, 2015 Edition 2017, v13 Cures 2023. Expanded to 40 states by 2014.
ONC certification details for Sevocity v13.0, certified 12/30/2022. Lists 40+ certified modules, 22 CQMs, and pricing for interfaces and features.
Parent company CMI founded 1990 by Elaine Mendoza. Started with DoD contracts (Air Force, Army, Navy). Launched Sevocity EHR in 2002. Also serves BARDA/HHS.
Lists 12 PM/billing partner integrations (AMS, BrickMed, DuxWare, EZClaim, PracticeAdmin, PracticeSuite, Puredi, etc.). Reveals EHR-only architecture with partner billing.
2018 announcement of Sevocity Premier: all-in-one EHR + PM with integrated clearinghouse, unlimited claims, ERAs. Two-tier product approach.
Supports 40+ specialties including surgical, medical, mental health, urgent care, PT. Emphasis on customization per specialty and practice.
Cloud-based, accessible anywhere in US. Pre-built lab and PM interfaces. No 3rd party costs. 4-6 week go-live. 99.5% uptime. ICD-10 with favorites lists.
Features: EPCS e-prescribing, patient portal, direct messaging, scheduling, integrated clearinghouse, claim status, ERA, eligibility verification.
Knowledge base: Orders/referrals tab for lab/diagnostic orders with CPT/HCPCS/SNOMED, eLab via Quest, specimen tracking, referrals via Direct protocol.
Cloud-based, 30+ specialties, charting templates, patient portal, e-prescribing with drug interaction alerts, solo to small groups.
PM suite with demographics/billing/scheduling. Patient portal, e-prescribing, e-faxing. Supports 30+ specialties. iPad/mobile accessible.
Features: e-prescribing, flow sheets, patient portal, appointment/billing mgmt, EM coding, lab integration, voice recognition, referrals, reporting. 28+ specialties. Solo to 50+ providers.
Revenue data: $2.9M in 2024, up from $2.1M in 2023. 18 total employees. Small vendor.
2019 press release: Sevocity named in Capterra Top 20 Most Popular EMR software.
